properties.name: The Flats
properties.coverage: ops call + Slate review + budget review
properties.headline: 86.6% occupied / 91.2% leased; 5 tours, 0 apps
properties.notes: Weekly ops (10/6): occupancy 86.6%, leased 91.17%; five recent tours produced no applications. S1R pricing cut from $1,070 to $970, $100 move-in credit on October starts, 5-touch follow-up rule. Slate review: high 80s occupancy, collections 95-98% (midpoint shown), September signed rents ~$965 with possible further 2% decline. New maintenance manager may start 10/13. Four units down since the monsoon event (tied to litigation). 2027 budget review (10/9): 8 active guarantor bonds, 62.5% renewal rate, bad-debt recovery cut to 20%, $5K roof contingency, Burns pest control at $342/mo.

properties.name: Nightingale on 25th
properties.headline: Still in receivership; no ops call
properties.notes: Only mention this week: RPM/Megan call (10/9) noted the asset remains under receivership and Megan will request a status update. Last known (W38-W40): ~80% occupancy, lender in operational control, flagged as a likely write-down to zero.

properties.name: The Julia
properties.headline: Trustee sale set for Dec 29; DPO proposal in progress
properties.notes: Ops (10/7): occupancy 89.68%, 13 move-ins expected in 30 days; ~25 leads, 5 tours, 1 application; target 5 apps by week end. Delinquency spans ~85 accounts across 54 units, 3 evictions in process; $12K Valley Kings settlement reached; work orders down to 45. Lender call (10/7): lender prefers to take control and sell rather than accept below-market financing or an A/B structure; a discounted note purchase (DPO) is the main viable path and DVO (David Valger) will submit sharpened terms by email. Trustee sale scheduled Dec 29 unless a viable alternative pauses it. Unauthorized buyer tours must now be denied without ownership approval. Greystar-managed.

properties.name: The Boardwalk
properties.headline: Below 85% occupancy despite up to 3 months free
properties.notes: Slate monthly (10/7): the most challenged asset; occupancy below 85% despite concessions of up to three months; Fort Myers new supply and weak demand. Renewal retention has dropped and residents are skipping (Megan/Garrett 10/6). Insurance recovery offsets some losses; lender-required parking lot repairs being bid (Rose Pavement). Downgraded from amber (87% in W40).

properties.name: Hanley Place
properties.headline: ~$795K-800K AP backlog; 92% occupied
properties.notes: Garrett site review (10/6): occupancy 92%, projected 94.3-94.8% in 30-60 days; 5 move-ins and 6 applications last week; rents +$25 (1-2BR) and +$35 (3BR); concession moves to one month free. Delinquency $72K current/notice plus $37K in eviction. Slate review (10/7) cited ~94% occupancy and 92% collections. AP ~$795K-800K tied to invoice-processing gaps; offsets under review: ~$300K tax refund, ~$100K lender repair holdback, JV funds as last resort. Washer/dryer count mismatch (75 in ledger vs 56 on site) being reconciled. Note: occupancy attributed from an unnamed Garrett site call referencing the Hanley mascot and Amanda.

properties.name: Skye at Conway
properties.headline: 95% occupied; Jan 9, 2027 maturity and liens
properties.notes: Ops (10/5-10/6): occupancy 95%, 97.27% pre-leased; delinquency collection improved from 75% to 92.69% (13 residents owe $23,990). One-bedroom concession moving to half-month free. Ready Carpet lien $14,163 plus other balances; IHG sync: one secured lien ($15K) and two threatened ($26K). Debt matures Jan 9, 2027; missed rate-cap purchase deadline means >$200K for a 3-month cap; ~$205K reserve release uncertain; Starwood modification talks ongoing.

properties.name: Skye Oaks (Palms at Palisades)
properties.headline: ~92% occupied, 96% collections (combined)
properties.notes: Reported as one combined campus with Brandon Oaks. Slate (10/7): ~92% occupancy, 96% collections, rent reductions and lease trade-outs. Electrical panel and GFCI work passed inspection; permit close-out docs going to lender; additional $13K insurance payout received. Washer/dryer replacements in some units created no premium (Capex one-pager).

properties.name: Skye Reserve
properties.coverage: weekly ops + IHG sync + daily AM
properties.headline: 78.4% occupied; MF1 says no 2027 break-even
properties.notes: Ops (10/6): occupancy stabilized at 78.41% after leasing cleanup; ~17% of units available; only 2 new apps pending plus ~6 Section 8 applicants. Yardi down units corrected to 15 (IHG cites 33 down units). Collections accuracy ~83-87% (midpoint shown). $250 gift-card pilot for month-end move-ins. Bilingual senior maintenance manager starts 10/13. AP fell from $1.2M to $975K. IHG sync: MF1 underwriting shows no break-even in 2027 even with a $10M note buy-down; BOVs requested. 265 residents moved out before lease expiration; RPM attorney says the addendum may not allow concession recharge.

properties.name: Skye at Hunter's Creek
properties.headline: 92.5% occupied; $51K opex shortfall; JV funding needed
properties.notes: Ops (10/5): occupancy 92.5%, ~94% projected in 30 days; no tours prior week; mixed renewal outlook; reserved-parking prices reduced. Budget review (10/9): T12 NOI ~$2.65M vs reforecast $2.67M questioned; market rents to be held flat (local comps -1.1%); insurance down ~25%; 2027 turn costs ~$173K. $51K operating-expense shortfall and JV funding need. Downgraded from green.

properties.name: Park at Peachtree Hills

Available-unit pricing rising to $1,165-1,175. J4 partial renovation targeting $1,299 rent and Nov 1 move-in. Slate: ~95% occupancy; $33K insurance reimbursement offsets $17K rent credits. AP ~$19K.

properties.name: Upland Townhomes
properties.headline: 92% occupied; Oct collections 74% MTD; 23 evictions
properties.notes: Ops (10/7): occupancy 92%, 6 move-ins / 5 move-outs in 30 days, 9 applications last week. September renewals 77.78%. Delinquency: 40 tenants 0-31 days, 23 pending evictions; October collections 74% MTD (needs ~$100K to reach 96.6%). C1 rent to $1,599, $250 concession on B1P. Building 2 underground plumbing repairs ~$20K-28K; insurance claim planned. Budget review (10/5) found payroll burden at 38% vs PMA 36% and ~$37K padded turn costs.

properties.name: Ninety-Nine 44
properties.headline: 83.9% occupied; 77.6% 0-30 day collections
properties.notes: Walnut portfolio ops (10/6): occupancy 83.85%; $750 move-in special spread over 3 months on units vacant 100+ days; A1 pricing to $799; $500 second-month discount. Collections 77.6% (0-30 days), target 95% in five weeks with mortgage due the 10th. Replacing maintenance manager; goal of 90% occupancy by next cycle. ~$8K historical receivable to review. Downgraded from amber.

Last known (W40): needs pricing, promotions and staffing support; tax litigation (valued at $16.7M).

properties.name: Chimney Hill
properties.headline: 86% collections; skips; fire units excluded
properties.notes: Weekly update (10/6): rent collection 86%, unexpected skips with Aug-Oct balances; TikTok drove 2,000 views and 6-7 applications; classic 1BR pricing cut $125-200; $500 renewal concession for rents 5%+ above market. Symmetre: 14 fire-affected units excluded (denominator 240 to 226). Fire-project permits resubmitted; pre-construction meeting in ~2 weeks. Only active tax appeal is Chimney Hill. Mike to explore an Isle/Love-style collections bonus. Upgraded from red to amber as the fire project is moving toward construction.

properties.name: Skye Isle
properties.headline: 95.1% occupied; 99.5% collections
properties.notes: Weekly update (10/6): occupancy 95.1%, $25 rent increases on select units. RPM catch-up (10/9): collections 99.5%, among the top three in the portfolio, helped by $500 manager bonuses at 95%+; renewals typically above 70%. $130K spent on patio stack wood-rot repairs; HCP designation still under city review; security issues near Joe's Creek (armed guards at night). Note: 10/6 call cited ~93.8% collections; 10/9 figure shown.

properties.name: Skye at Love
properties.headline: 92.95% occupied; collections 98% (conflicting 77.5%)
properties.notes: Weekly update (10/6): occupancy 92.95%, collections 77.50%; Lease AI trial approved to improve call response. RPM catch-up (10/9): collections 98%. The two figures likely use different periods (Oct MTD vs September close) and need reconciling. Underground water-line breaks continue; assistant manager resigned and is being replaced; homelessness/vandalism near Joe's Creek.

properties.name: Skye Ridge
properties.headline: AP $408K; $50K waterfall applied; $400K capital call
properties.notes: AP call (10/8): $50K lender waterfall applied against a $407,901 balance, legal and lien items first; Air Max lien cleared with $7,200 redirected; $360K priority balance to be communicated to Craig. Opex averaging ~$138K/month; another waterfall expected later this month. Megan/Murlidhar (10/5): $400K capital call includes $360K Atlantic Creek share; cash modeled positive through the June 2027 maturity subject to expense control. No occupancy reported.
